portal.vendor_source: portal fingerprint: Server sfdcedge, Salesforce Lightning/Aura page shell, redirect to be-register-view?c__r=Arcus_BE_Public_Register

committee_papers.note: Committee ids confirmed by the Modern.gov web service (GetCommittees) on 2026-09-26. Wiltshire splits planning between a strategic committee and four area planning committees. No committee document downloaded.

reference_format.note: PL/YYYY/NNNNN, with a zero-padded five-digit serial. Arcus record ids (18-character Salesforce ids) are separate and cannot be built from the reference.

browser_route.note: Open the register in a browser and search for the reference. No known URL parameter pre-fills the search; PlanIt's applics url (…/pr/s/planning-application/<18-char id>) is a record deep link where PlanIt has the case.

quirks.summary: Arcus (Salesforce Experience Cloud) register with no anonymous API surface; the page is a Lightning shell, not data.
quirks.detail: bot_protection is deliberately null: nothing challenged the client. The obstacle is architectural, and the skill does not reverse-engineer the Arcus managed-package controllers.
quirks.workaround: Hand the user the browser route. PlanIt's applics url is a ready record deep link where it has one.

quirks.summary: PlanIt's planning_url and record links use /pr/s/; the landing page now redirects to /pr3/s/be-register-view.
quirks.workaround: Use the register URL above for a search; PlanIt's /pr/s/planning-application/<id> record links were not tested.

pacing.note: Three requests at 5 s spacing on 2026-09-26 (register page, robots.txt) with no 429 or challenge. Nothing was attempted on the Arcus controllers.

robots.note: Default Salesforce communities robots.txt: 'User-agent: *' with 'Allow: /', disallowing only the password-reset path.

verification.note: PlanIt's areas record gave https://development.wiltshire.gov.uk/pr/s/?tabset-167f1=3, which redirected (301) to the Arcus register at /pr3/s/be-register-view. One GET confirmed Arcus: Server sfdcedge and a Lightning/Aura shell with no register data. robots.txt fetched. PlanIt's applics records gave PL/2026/06083 and PL/2026/05739 with /pr/s/planning-application/<id> links. No download attempted: Arcus is browser-only. Modern.gov GetCommittees checked for the committee ids.
